name: Audiobook Library
description: Plays audiobooks in a chapter-aware player styled after Audiobookshelf's. The now-playing bar shows chapter marks and the current chapter, with chapter skip, 10-second skips, speed and a chapter list. On phones, tapping the bar opens a full-page player. Playback speed is remembered for each book and each user.
overview: Chapter-aware audiobook player for Jellyfin's web client and apps

versions.changelog: First stable release of the chapter-aware player. Audiobooks get their own now-playing bar styled after Audiobookshelf's, with chapter marks, previous and next chapter, 10-second skips, speed and a chapter list. On phones, tapping the bar opens a full-page player. Chapters work across split M4B and multi-file MP3 books, and stopping keeps your place in Continue Listening. New since 0.1.4.2: playback speed is remembered for each book and each user.
